task.title: Setting a Clair database to managed
task.shortdesc: To have the Red Hat Quay Operator manage your Clair database, you can set the clairpostgres component to managed in your QuayRegistry custom resource.

step.cmd: In the Quay Operator, set the clairpostgres component of the QuayRegistry custom resource to managed: true:

info.codeblock: apiVersion: quay.redhat.com/v1 kind: QuayRegistry metadata: name: quay370 spec: configBundleSecret: config-bundle-secret components: - kind: objectstorage managed: false - kind: route managed: true - kind: tls managed: false - kind: clairpostgres managed: true
